## Problem
The task-builder's generated **POST-reflect gate item** emitted:
```
/sc:reflect --mode post --diff <start_commit>..HEAD ...
```
where `start_commit` is `git rev-parse HEAD` captured at task start (frontmatter `start_commit`). That base is **wrong in two common cases**:

1. **Uncommitted work (the usual `/task` outcome).** `/task` edits the working tree but does not commit, so a `<base>..HEAD` *commit range* audits **none** of the task's changes.
2. **Interleaved commits.** If an unrelated commit lands on the branch after task start, `start_commit..HEAD` spans **foreign work**.

Both were hit live while auditing the PRD `--file` fix (#151): `start_commit` (`ac80f176`) pointed before an unrelated sprint-recovery commit, and the PRD work was uncommitted on top — so `ac80f176..HEAD` covered only the foreign commit. The reflect run had to be hand-retargeted to the working-tree diff.

## Fix
Derive `<BASE>` as the branch's fork point — `git merge-base HEAD <integration-branch>` (default `origin/master`) — and pass it as a **single ref** so `/sc:reflect` diffs it against the **working tree** (capturing committed *and* uncommitted changes). `sc-reflect-protocol` already accepts a single ref (`--diff <ref-or-path>` = ref-vs-working-tree). `start_commit` is retained in frontmatter for provenance only, never as the diff base.

## Change
- `src/superclaude/cli/prd/...` n/a — single-line edit to `src/superclaude/skills/task-builder/SKILL.md:2195` (the templated POST-reflect Action the builder copies into every generated task file).
- `make sync-dev` propagated to the `.claude/` mirror; `verify-sync` shows `task-builder ✅` (the unrelated persona-research/recommend drift is pre-existing on master).

## Scope
Documentation/template only — 1 tracked line. No code or test changes. Future generated task files emit the working-tree-aware POST-reflect command.

title: fix(task-builder): base POST-reflect --diff on merge-base working-tree, not start_commit
